messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: In the Mounjaro prescribing information, SURPASS-1 (NCT03954834) was a 40-week trial.
The trial was in adults with type 2 diabetes.
The adults had blood sugar that was not adequately controlled with diet and exercise alone.
Patients received once-weekly Mounjaro 5 mg, 10 mg, or 15 mg, or placebo.
After 40 weeks, 78% to 85% of adults taking Mounjaro achieved an HbA1c below 7%.
This is compared with 23% of adults taking a placebo.
The average HbA1c change was -1.8% with Mounjaro 5 mg.
The average HbA1c change was -1.7% with Mounjaro 10 mg.
The average HbA1c change was -1.7% with Mounjaro 15 mg.
The average HbA1c change was -0.1% with placebo.
Triplet: ["adults with type 2 diabetes", "had condition", "blood sugar not adequately controlled with diet and exercise alone"]

The relation 'had condition' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject population had the specified medical condition or health status.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'have': The subject group of patients has the medical condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
B. 'occurs in': The subject medical condition is observed or experienced by the group of individuals specified by the object entity.
C. 'may indicate': The subject condition or symptom may be a sign or indicator of the medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'has severity': The medical condition or effect specified by the subject has the severity specified by the object entity.
E. 'related to': The subject drug is associated with the medical condition or disease specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
